products.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product tp join product p on p.id = tp.product_id where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and p.deleted_at is null

products_by_status.sql: select p.status, count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product tp join product p on p.id = tp.product_id where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and p.deleted_at is null group by p.status order by p.status

variants.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product tp join product_variant v on v.product_id = tp.product_id where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and v.deleted_at is null

categories.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product_category where tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M'

category_links.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product tp join product_category_product cp on cp.product_id = tp.product_id where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M'

images.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product tp join image i on i.product_id = tp.product_id where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and i.deleted_at is null

thumbnails.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product tp join product p on p.id = tp.product_id where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and p.deleted_at is null and p.thumbnail is not null

prices_by_currency.sql: select pr.currency_code, count(*)::int as n from tenant_tenant_product_product tp join product_variant v on v.product_id = tp.product_id join product_variant_price_set vps on vps.variant_id = v.id join price pr on pr.price_set_id = vps.price_set_id and pr.deleted_at is null where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and v.deleted_at is null group by pr.currency_code order by pr.currency_code

product_translations.sql: select count(*)::int as n from translation t join tenant_tenant_product_product tp on tp.product_id = t.reference_id where tp.tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and t.reference = 'product'

pages.sql: select locale, count(*)::int as n from tenant_page where tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M' and deleted_at is null group by locale order by locale

home.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_home_config where tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M'

domains.sql: select count(*)::int as n from tenant_domain where tenant_id = 'ten_01M29Q4KYQHC70JZBENWZ8Z88M'
